 Order
This first application under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail.
2. Applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.297/2024 registered at Police Station Malharganj, Indore for offence under Section 420, 120- B of IPC.
3. After arguing the matter at length, counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application.
4. It is accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn .
